measured.value: Title/status and Terminal cards render; Playwright screenshot and generated image artifacts do not appear inline in the Happy conversation view observed by the user.

expected.source: User request and completed specialist findings require screenshot/generated-image outputs to render as inline visual artifacts while existing text/terminal/generic tool rendering stays intact.

root_cause_analysis.summary: Image-capable renderer exists for preview URI payloads, but screenshot/generated-image tool outputs are normalized/rendered as generic JSON/path-only records without a browser-loadable image preview.

development_approach.summary: Add or connect canonical image preview handling for image-like tool outputs while preserving existing generic tool rendering.
constraints: Do not redesign general Happy rendering quality
Do not regress title/status, Terminal, or generic non-image tool cards

acceptance_criteria: Playwright screenshot result displays an inline image in conversation view.
AI-generated image result displays an inline image in conversation view.
Path-only image-view result is explicitly handled and verified.
Existing title/status, Terminal, and generic non-image MCP tool-card rendering remains intact.
Desktop and mobile layouts avoid page-level horizontal overflow.
Verification uses dev web only; no production access; no API-created sessions.
